input.prompt:
Analyze the following Gmail message context.

Message 1
Date: 2024-06-01
To: 
From: boss@corp.com
Subject: 
Message_body: Deadline today
Structured_thread: Current message:
datetime: 2024-06-01
sender: boss@corp.com
content: Deadline today

Previous messages: None

Output instructions:
Return plain text only.
For each input message, output exactly one priority word on its own line, in the same order as the input messages.
Allowed priority words: low, medium, high, urgent.
There is no normal priority for Analyzer Agent output. If a message feels ordinary but still asks the user to do something, use high or medium, never normal.
Do not return JSON, labels, Gmail metadata, reasoning, markdown, or tool calls.
Do not draft a reply.
